verdict.rationale: Quo's own marketing says teams can 'Share one number and stay aligned with your team', so the core shared-number capability is documented. Call routing and ring orders are related call-handling features, but they are not presence, assignment, or internal threads. Missing for 10: documented teammate presence/availability indicators, conversation assignment to specific teammates, internal comment threads on conversations, and any in-depth docs or hands-on corroboration of shared-inbox collaboration.
